name: by Amazon still spring water, 6 x 2 litre
note: Three packs cover four people for three days. Any supermarket own brand is the same water; buy the shape that stacks.

name: John West tuna chunks in spring water, 4 x 125 g
note: One of the things to buy, not the whole shelf. Ring-pull tins need no opener.

name: Heinz baked beans, 6 x 415 g
note: They are cooked in the tin, so they can be eaten cold. Buy what you already eat.

name: Xtralite NiteSafe 3-in-1 plug-in power-failure torch
note: Charges in the socket and switches on the instant the power drops.

name: Xtralite NiteSafe Duo with motion sensor
note: The motion sensor makes it a night light the rest of the year.

name: Energizer Vision HD+ head torch, 360 lumens
note: Runs on three AAA cells, which every shop sells. Keep a spare set beside it, not in it.

name: Ledlenser MH3 head torch, 200 lumens
note: Brighter and heavier, on one AA cell; one for whoever goes outside.

name: Ugreen Nexode power bank, 25,000 mAh, 140 W
note: Charges a phone four or five times and a laptop once.

name: Anker power bank, 25,000 mAh, 165 W
note: The dearer option if you need to keep a laptop running.

name: Philips TAR1609 wind-up FM radio with torch
note: FM and AM only, but it runs on AAA cells, solar or the handle.

name: Roberts Play 20 DAB+ and FM on AA cells
note: Pair it with twelve lithium AA cells; the cells are the real backup.

name: Roberts SolarDAB 99, refurbished by Roberts
note: DAB+, FM, crank and solar in one set. Roberts was selling it only as a refurbished set when we looked.

name: Portable toilet bags with absorbent gel powder, pack of 30
note: Thirty bags is about two a person a day for a household of four over three days, so buy two packs if you want room to spare.

name: CarpLife Bivvy Loo refill pack: 12 liners, 12 powder sachets and 40 wipes
note: Liners, powder and wipes in one box, which is the whole job for two people for three days.

name: CarpLife Bivvy Loo absorbent powder, 1 kg
note: A kilogram of the powder alone, to go with strong bin bags you already have.

name: Mini DC UPS for routers, 10,400 mAh
note: Read the voltage on your router's own plug first and buy a unit that gives the same.

name: APC Back-UPS Connect CP12036LI 12 V mini UPS
note: Made for routers by the company that makes the office ones, for a router that takes 12 volts.

name: FireAngel FA6813 ten-year carbon monoxide alarm
note: Sealed battery, no maintenance for ten years.

name: Kidde FB1 fire blanket, 1.1 metre
note: Hang it by the cooker, not above it.

name: St John Ambulance universal first-aid kit
note: Add two weeks of any prescription medicines yourself.

name: Price's Sentinel eight-hour tea lights, pack of 100
note: Stand them in jars: a jar stops a knocked candle becoming a fire.

name: Find an Arboricultural Association approved contractor
note: The price is yours to ask. MyBuilder's guide puts a standard report on a garden's trees at £150 to £300.

name: 300 W car power inverter, 12 V to 240 V, with USB-C
note: Enough to charge laptops and power banks from the car.

name: Airbrick flood water defence cover and frame
note: One for each air brick. Fit the frames now and the covers go on in seconds when a warning comes.

name: HydroSack flood barrier, pack of two
note: They swell when wet, so they store flat and light until they are needed.

name: FloodSax sandless sandbags, pack of five
note: Lighter than sandbags and they store flat. A doorway takes four or five.

name: Ubric water leak alarm, 9 V battery
note: A loud alarm with a probe on a lead, so the box can sit above where the water will be.

name: Sebson water alarm with a ten-year battery
note: Sealed for ten years, so there is no battery to forget.

name: Drive DeVilbiss folding lightweight commode, 5 litre pan
note: Folds flat behind a door until it is needed. Check the weight it is rated for.

name: Jay-Be ME70 folding bed with mattress, single
note: Only if there is no bed or sofa downstairs already. It wheels into a cupboard.

name: 25 litre food-grade water container
note: Four of these is a hundred litres; keep them dark and off concrete. A tap for the cap is sold separately.

name: Oasis water purification tablets, 33 mg, 100
note: One tablet treats five litres, so five to a 25 litre can lets stored tap water keep.

name: Bath water storage bag, 378 litres
note: Fills from the tap when a warning comes. Check the listing says food-grade before you buy.

name: Wickes water butt kit, 210 litres
note: For flushing and washing, never drinking untreated. The stand is £12.50 more.

name: Liberty easy cook long grain rice, 5 kg
note: About fifty portions. Build the month by buying one extra of what you already eat each shop.

name: Wholefood Earth porridge oats, 3 kg
note: Oats keep for a year in a sealed tub and need only water.

name: Lakeland Dairies long life semi skimmed milk, 12 x 1 litre
note: Keeps for months unopened and without a fridge.

name: Felix Original mixed selection in jelly, 40 x 85 g
note: About a fortnight for one cat. Buy what yours already eats; a change of food in a bad week helps nobody.

name: Harringtons Complete dry adult dog food, salmon and potato, 12 kg
note: A sack is a month or more for a medium dog. Buy what yours already eats.

name: WaterWipes baby wipes, 12 packs
note: Wipes are also how everyone washes when the water is off.

name: Pampers Baby-Dry nappies, size 4, 222
note: A monthly box in the size your baby is in now, and the next size up if a change is near.

name: Campingaz Camp Bistro 3 cartridge stove with four CP 250 cartridges
note: The stove and its first four cartridges together; about two hours per cartridge on full. Outside only.

name: Butane gas canisters, 227 g, pack of four
note: Ten cartridges is a week of hot meals.

name: Thermos Stainless King flask, 1.2 litre
note: Warm it with a little boiling water first and it holds its heat for a day.

name: Stanley Classic Legendary flask, 1.9 litre
note: The big one: most of a kettle, hot the next morning.

name: Valiant FIR421 moisture meter for firewood
note: Logs are ready to burn under 20 per cent. Split one and test the fresh face.

name: Find a HETAS registered chimney sweep
note: The price is yours to ask. Checkatrade's guide puts the average sweep at £90, more for a chimney left over two years.

name: Straame portable gas heater, 4.2 kW, three heat settings
note: Low is 1.5 kW, the setting the plan counts on. It cuts out if the air runs short of oxygen, the flame fails or it is knocked over.

name: Calor 15 kg butane gas bottle, new, with its refill agreement
note: The blue bottle is the one for an indoor heater. The first costs more because it comes with the agreement to swap an empty for a full one.

name: Calor 15 kg butane gas bottle, a full one for an empty one
note: Swap the empty for a full one before winter. A second bottle of your own costs more, because it comes with its refill agreement.

name: Voyager sleeping bag for adults, three to four season
note: One each, in the one room you will keep warm.

name: Long-reach refillable gas lighter
note: Keep it by the cooker.

name: Ledlenser ML4 rechargeable mini lantern
note: One per occupied bedroom; forty-five hours on low.

name: Ledlenser ML6 Warm Light lantern
note: For the living room; two hundred hours on low and it charges a phone.

name: Sentry Safe 1210 fire box with key lock
note: Cash, passports, insurance, prescriptions and an encrypted memory stick.

name: Wickes starter hose pipe set with sprayer head, 30 metres
note: It has to reach the back fence.

name: FireShield fire blanket in a hard case, 1.8 metre
note: Hang it by the back door.

name: Bluetti 200 W folding solar panel
note: Tops up rather than sustains in a Welsh winter; recharges the smaller station in a summer day.

name: Bluetti Elite 100 V2, 1,024 Wh
note: The 1 kWh size, for a house that will fit rooftop solar with backup within a year.

name: Bluetti Elite 200 V2, 2,074 Wh
note: The 2 kWh size runs the fridge-freezer for fourteen hours.

name: British Berkefeld 6 litre gravity filter with Ultra Sterasyl candles
note: Drinking water from the water butt, a stream or rain.

name: Starlink Roam, 100 GB a month, with Standby mode
note: The price is for a month in use; Starlink shows the price of the dish, and of Standby, when you order.
